name: Dan Patrick
description: Delivers scores in the register of mid-nineties highlight shows: a rundown at the start of the day and an alert as each game finishes. You must first specify the teams and leagues in the placeholder field, since it tracks nothing until told.

official.title: Dan Patrick by Marcus
official.description: Your personal sports anchor. It sends a daily 90s SportsCenter-style video rundown of your teams' finals, top performers and standings, and pings you...
